ModMetaData.name: Pawn Aim Regions 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Independent RimWorld 1.5 combat targeting mod. Player humanlike pawns can choose Head, Torso, or Lower Body aim from a per-pawn Gizmo. Player pawns default to Torso. NPC humanlike pawns receive a persistent random aim preference: Head 35%, Torso 45%, Lower Body 20%. Applies to normal melee and ranged injury hit-part selection while preserving vanilla damage, armor, penetration, coverage weighting, and explicit hit-part assignments from other systems.
